name: Murmur
rationale: Keep the warmth of Murmur and give it a more tactile identity. A folded lowercase m feels like a small object you keep on your desk: useful, familiar, and beautifully made. Warm paper, deep evergreen ink, and a restrained clay accent bring character without competing with the Mac around it.
logoIdea: Two soft arches become a folded lowercase m. Their diagonal endings suggest a continuous ribbon, turning a voice into a line of text. The solid silhouette stays readable in the menu bar; enlarged folds become a calm graphic language.

names.name: Murmur
names.reason: The strongest continuity: human, memorable, and naturally quiet.
